label: How Auto-fit spreads the lines over the recording

params.name: gap_seconds
params.label: The breath kept between two lines

params.name: min_line_seconds
params.label: The shortest a line may be

params.name: tail_seconds
params.label: Silence kept at the very end

params.name: spread_to_end
params.label: Stretch a short script so it covers the whole recording

params.name: keep_first_start
params.label: Leave the first line where the author put it

description_nl: Auto-fit gives every line the time its own words need at words_per_second, keeps a gap_seconds breath between lines, and then stretches or squeezes the whole set to end tail_seconds before the recording does. With spread_to_end off, a script shorter than the recording keeps its natural pace and simply finishes early. Order and wording are never touched - only the clock.
weight_basis: Timing only, no wording. Slower speakers, longer gaps: change the knobs, never the code.
